title: The Names before Atzilus and after it: light, vessel and the kavanos
overview:
The chapter applies the last chapter's examples to the three vessels of brain and heart. The light of *Atzilus*, like the light of the intellect still united with its source, is only a revelation, like a color, and still it is called ten *sefiros bli ma*: a color is essential too. A ripe apple cannot be the wrong color, and a truly kind man cannot enjoy cruelty.

The lights come from the essential letters of the one who emanates them, the Names *Ayin Beis* and *SaG* of *Adam Kadmon*, as a man's revealed will comes from the name he calls himself. The vessel is the light thickened into matter, like an idea set in the brain. There are two kinds of Names: inner ones before *Atzilus* and outer ones after it, the limiting vessels, as a cat has an inner name that makes it a cat and an outer name we call it by. Say "mouse" to a baker and he knows the whole story: whoever intends the outer name intends the inner one. That is what the *kavanos* of the *Arizal* are. And the limiting vessels are *tikunim*, fixings, like glasses: only through them can the light come down.

sections.title: Only a color, and still essential: ten sefiros without a what
sections.summary: The light of *Atzilus* is a revelation, only like a color, yet it is still called ten *sefiros bli ma*. A color is essential too: a ripe apple cannot be the wrong color, and a truly kind man cannot enjoy cruelty.

phrases.he: (כח) והנמשל מדוגמא זו הוא בבחינת ג' כלים דמוחא ולבא כו' בדרך כלל על כל פנים דאור החכמה דאצילות מצד אצילותה מעצמות אור המאציל, הרי זה כאור השכל הרוחני עצמו שנמשך מעצם כח החכמה שבבחינת עצמות הנפש
שמתאחד הוא עדיין במקור חוצבו ממש
phrases.en: which is all of it *batel*.

phrases.he: כשלהבת כו' או גם כגלוי הרצון הנזכר לעיל מעצם הרצון דבחינת אדם קדמון הגם שזהו כמו מראה וגוון בלבד,
(כמו שכתוב למעלה
phrases.en: Like it is explained before,

phrases.he: בענין קורא הדורות מראש שזהו עשר ספירות דאצילות שיצאו מהעלם דאדם קדמון שהוא גילוי רצון בדבר נבדל כו' בסוף אות הי"ט)

blocks.text: The *nimshal* (the thing the example stands for) is the three vessels of *mocha* and *liba*, brain and heart. The light of *chachma* of *Atzilus*, as it is emanated from the Essence of the light of the *ma'atzil* (the one who emanates), is like the spiritual light of the intellect drawn from the essential power of *chachma* in the soul, still united with its source: **which is all of it *batel*** (nullified). So too the revelation of the will from the essence of the will in *Adam Kadmon*, even though this is only like an appearance and a color, as explained before.

phrases.he: עם כל זה נקרא עשר ספירות בלי מ''ה, בלי מהות עדיין
phrases.en: Even though it's already a *gilui ratzon* or a *gilui chachma*, it's still really a *bli ma*: the light is still a *bli ma*.

phrases.he: כי כמו שהגוון הוא גם כן עצמי, שאי אפשר להיות גוון היפוכו לדבר בעצם
phrases.en: Even though the *gavan* is different from the thing that it's *moreh* on, the *gavan* is really also *atzmi*: you can't have an opposite color from what it is.

phrases.he: כגוון התפוח בלובן, להורות על עצם טעם המתיקות שבו

blocks.text: Even so, they are called ten *sefiros bli ma*, without a what, without a *mahus* yet. **It's already a *gilui ratzon* or a *gilui chachma*** (a revelation of the will or of wisdom), and the light is still *bli ma*. For the *gavan* (color) is also *atzmi* (essential). The color is different from the thing it is *moreh* on (points to), but **you can't have an opposite color from what it is**.

blocks.title: The color of the apple
blocks.text: The color of an apple points to the essence of its sweetness. The color is not the sweetness, but it is still *atzmi*, because that is the color it has to be: it can't be all brown inside and be a nice, ripe apple, perfect to eat.

phrases.he: וכן אור השכל ורצון מטה כלפי חסד,
גם שהוא בענין נבדל,
phrases.en: even though it's in a different thing: it's not actually just pure *chesed*, it's like a thing to give money or to find a guy innocent.

phrases.he: מאחר שהוא מורה על העצם כו'

blocks.text: So too the light of the intellect, and a will that leans toward *chesed* (kindness): **even though it's in a different thing**, not pure *chesed* but giving money or finding a man innocent, it still points to the essence: he loves.

blocks.title: The kind man and the lions
blocks.text: You cannot have a very kind man whose revealed will is to torture animals. The revealed will is in a *davar nivdal* (a separate thing): being nice to animals or torturing them, or to people. But a really kind man, like *Avraham Avinu*, will not enjoy throwing people to the lions.

That is a thing of Esav. And the same the other way: if you have an Esav, as the Romans were, then the circuses, even though they are a *davar nivdal*, are the *etzem* (essence) of the Romans. Like the color to the apple.

sensitivity.reason: Says cruelty, the circuses, was the very essence of the Romans, and ties it to Esav.

blocks.text: So *Atzilus*, even though it is only a revelation, a *gilui*, has to be *davka* like that. It is really an *etzem*, because it points *davka* to the *etzem*.

sections.title: The Names of the Emanator: the self-image the lights come from
sections.summary: The lights of the ten *sefiros* come from the essential letters of the one who emanates them, the Names *Ayin Beis* and *SaG* of *Adam Kadmon*. They are like a man's self-image, the name he calls himself, from which all his revealed will comes.

phrases.he: ולכך כל התהוות אורות דעשר ספירות הן באים מבחינת אותיות עצמיים דמאצילן
phrases.en: They come from the *etzem osios* of the *ma'atzil*.

blocks.text: So all the lights of the ten *sefiros* come into being from the essential *osios* (letters) of the one who emanates them: **they come from the *etzem osios* of the *ma'atzil***. That is, from his self-image. From the *Adam Kadmon* of the Romans, their self-image, came the circuses.

sensitivity.reason: Repeats the Romans' circuses as coming from their essential self-image.

phrases.he: וכמו שם ע''ב, שממנו בא בחינת אור החכמה דאצילות בגילוי הרי זה שם המורה על עצם דחכמה דאדם קדמון כו'
וכן שם ס''ג המורה על עצם אור דבינה דאדם קדמון כו'
והן ע''ב ס''ג כו' שלפני עשר ספירות דאצילות,
phrases.en: So this is the name that's before; in other words, that's the *osios* of *Adam Kadmon* it's talking about.

phrases.he: ונקרא שמות המאציל כו'
phrases.en: And these are called the names of the *ma'atzil* of *Adam Kadmon*.

blocks.text: The Name *Ayin Beis* (seventy-two), from which the light of *chachma* of *Atzilus* comes in revelation, points to the essence of *chachma* of *Adam Kadmon*; the Name *SaG* (sixty-three), to the essence of *bina* of *Adam Kadmon*. These are the Names before the ten *sefiros* of *Atzilus*: **the *osios* of *Adam Kadmon***. They are basically like vessels, but the point is that from the end of *Adam Kadmon* comes the beginning of *Atzilus*. So they are **called the names of the *ma'atzil* of *Adam Kadmon***.

phrases.he: וכמו בחינת האחרונה שבצורה הרוחניות
phrases.en: Like the end of the *tzura ruchanis*, the letters of the *tzura ruchanis*,

phrases.he: שמקושר אל תחילת התהוות האור והצורה בכלי החומר כו'
כנזכר לעיל בדם הוא הנפש
phrases.en: Like for instance, from the letters of the soul comes the programming of the blood.

phrases.he: ובצמיחה הרוחנית ובעין ומוח כו'
phrases.en: Like all the examples from the last chapter.

blocks.text: The last level of the *tzura ruchanis* (the spiritual form), its letters, is bound up with the beginning of the light and the form coming into being in the vessels of matter. It is what was explained before: from the letters of the Rebbe comes the *ratzon* of the *chassid*. Here it is inside a person: the letters of his self-image are where the light of his revealed will comes from.

blocks.title: What a man calls himself
blocks.text: The Names are like what a man calls himself in his self-image. He calls himself a philanthropist. Or a Roman: "Friends, Romans, countrymen" means that is what we are, Romans. Or we are Pittsburghers, we like the Steelers; or a Democrat, or a Republican. If his self-image is that he is a Hatfield, out of it comes hating McCoys, a *gevura* and a *davar nivdal*. Where does the light of that hatred come from? From the name of his self-image, what he finally calls himself. These are the Names *Ayin Beis*, *SaG*, *MaH*, *BaN* of *Adam Kadmon*: as he calls himself, so the light and the form come into being in the vessels of matter.

So it is in the soul: **from the letters of the soul comes the programming of the blood**, and so in the spiritual growth, the eye and the brain, **all the examples from the last chapter**. That is the matter of the *osios*.

sections.title: The vessel: the light already set in the matter of the brain
sections.summary: The vessel of *chachma* is like an idea already held in the matter of the brain, which takes only the thickened end of the light and changes it from spiritual to physical; so a man is "smart". The same three vessels, brain, heart and liver, are above, in *Zeir Anpin*.

phrases.he: אבל בחינת הכלי המגביל האור דחכמה דאצילות,
הוא כמו אור השכל שממוזג כבר בחומר המוח
phrases.en: That's how the idea is already inside the mind.

phrases.he: שחומר המוח מקבל רק מהתעבות סוף אור השכל
phrases.en: It only receives the thickening of the end of the light of the actual *sechel*.

phrases.he: על כן מגבילו, מלבד שינוי המהות כו'
phrases.en: besides the fact that it changes the *mahus* from a spiritual *mahus* to a physical *mahus*.

phrases.he: כך הוא אור החכמה כשמתלבש במוחא, ונקרא חכמה מוחא כו'
phrases.en: It's called *mamash* the same thing: *chachma* is called *mocha*.

phrases.he: שאז מצד בחינת כלי החכמה הוא בא בשם מציאות דבר שכל,
הנקרא התחכמות דבר מה
phrases.en: Smartness, it's *chochmas davar ma*: his ideas. What shows you that he's such a smart guy, the *metzius davar* of the *davar sechel*, is these ideas that he came up with.

phrases.he: בפרט
phrases.en: In particular, *hischakmus*es.

blocks.text: But the vessel that limits the light of *chachma* of *Atzilus* is like the light of the intellect already set in the matter of the brain: **how the idea is already inside the mind**. The brain **only receives the thickening of the end of the light** of the intellect, so it limits it, besides changing its *mahus* from spiritual to physical. That is a bit more evident in the *koach hatnua* (the power of movement): in the muscle it is changed over to movement.

So the light of *chachma*, dressed in the brain, is called *chachma mocha*: **chachma is called *mocha*** (brain), *mamash* the same thing. That is from the side of the vessel: he's got brains, meaning he's smart. From the side of the vessel, *chachma* comes as a thing that exists, called *hischakmus* (being smart) in something in particular. What shows you he is such a smart guy is the ideas he came up with.

phrases.he: וכן המדות הרוחניים בלבא
phrases.en: The actual emotions in the heart,

phrases.he: והנפש הרוחניות בכבדא כו'
phrases.en: the gut emotions from the *nefesh* in the liver.

phrases.he: והן ענין ג' שליטין לעילה,
phrases.en: And this is the same thing upstairs.

phrases.he: בחינת ג' כלים כללים לנר''נ דזעיר אנפין דאצילות נשמה, שהוא בחינת מוחין דחכמה ובינה שבזעיר אנפין במוחא, ורוח בלבא כו'

blocks.text: So too the spiritual *middos* in the heart, **the actual emotions**, and the spiritual *nefesh* in the liver, **the gut emotions**. **This is the same thing upstairs**: the three general vessels for the *nefesh*, *ruach* and *neshama* of *Zeir Anpin* of *Atzilus*. *Neshama* is the *mochin* of *chachma* and *bina* in the brain, *ruach* is in the heart, and the *hispaalus* (excitement) of the *middos* is in the liver.

sections.title: Inner names and outer names: the cat and the mouse
sections.summary: The vessels of *Atzilus* are its letters, the Names *Ayin Beis*, *SaG*, *MaH*, *BaN* of *Atzilus*, made from the thickening of the light. There are two kinds of Names, one before *Atzilus* and one after it, as a cat has an inner name that makes it a cat and an outer name we call it by, which still tells the whole story.

phrases.he: והן האותיות דאורות דאצילות,
phrases.en: This is called the letters for the lights: the *kelim* are the letters of the lights of *Atzilus*.

phrases.he: שזהו ענין ד' שמות ע''ב ס''ג דאצילות כו'
phrases.en: These are the *Ayin Beis*, *SaG*, *MaH*, *BaN* of *Atzilus*.

blocks.text: These vessels are the letters of the lights: **the *kelim* are the letters of the lights of *Atzilus*** (the vessels), the four Names *Ayin Beis*, *SaG*, *MaH*, *BaN*. But these are different: **the *Ayin Beis*, *SaG*, *MaH*, *BaN* of *Atzilus***. There is an inner name and an outer name.

blocks.title: The inner name "cat"
blocks.text: You see a cat. What is that? You say: it's a cat. That is the external name, from the whole *chitzoniyus* (outside) of the thing. It comes from the inner name, the name "cat" inside it that says this is a cat. The inner name is not the same as the outer one: it makes it everything it is, its cat character, the amount of brains you expect from a cat. And yet that is also what the outer name means. The name is *davka* in Hebrew, as the *Tanya* says of *even* (stone). The end of the inner name is enclothed in the cat's DNA and tells it that it is a cat and not a frog.

blocks.title: The name "cat" above, down to this cat
blocks.text: So the inner name becomes the light that shows it what to be, the inner essence of its soul, like its *nefesh habehamis* (animal soul) in the blood; from the end of that comes the beginning of the physical DNA. It comes from the name "cat" in the *Ofanim* and in the holy *Chayos*, the face of the lion or of the bull; the combinations make this particular cat, brown or black and white, big or small.

blocks.title: Any cat with any cat
blocks.text: So it is not just the inner name "cat"? There is a species. Any cat can mate with any other cat; any dog, as long as it has the name "dog", with any other dog; but a dog and a cat won't mix. So there is a general name "cat", and then particulars all the way down to this particular cat.

So there is an outer name and an inner name, and in the inner name too an outer and an inner name, all the way up. The outer names of *Atzilus* are the vessels of *Zeir Anpin*; they go through *Malchus*, the total outer name of *Atzilus*, to the words of *Atzilus* in the ten utterances, which become the lights that make *Beriya*: "Let there be light." The outer names come from the inner names, which are the outer names of *Adam Kadmon*.

phrases.he: שנקרא כלים לעשר ספירות דאצילות המגבילים האור ומצמצמו,
לפי שמהתעבות האור נעשה הכלי,
phrases.en: Because from this *hisabus* of the light becomes the *kli*.

phrases.he: כמו שכתוב בעץ חיים
והוא הנקרא בחינת הישות של האור,
phrases.en: And that's the somethingness of the light,

phrases.he: כשנראה לבחינת יש ודבר מה במציאות כידוע ודי למבין
phrases.en: where it can be seen as a *yesh* and *davar ma*: in thought it's enough of a *yesh* and *davar ma* for myself to think of it, and in the words it *mamash* becomes enough of *metzius* to tell somebody else about it.

blocks.text: They are called the vessels of the ten *sefiros* of *Atzilus*, which limit the light and contract it, **because from this *hisabus* of the light becomes the *kli***: from the thickening of the light comes the vessel. You see it in the letters of thought and speech. To think in letters and then talk in letters, you have to grossen up the idea; the words he is saying now come from that.

This is called the *yeshus* (somethingness) of the light, when it is seen as a *yesh* and *davar ma* (something). In thought it is enough of a *yesh* for oneself to think of it; in words it *mamash* becomes enough of a *metzius* (existence) **to tell somebody else about it**.

phrases.he: (ונמצא ב' מיני שמות ע''ב ס''ג כו'
phrases.en: So we see that there's two kinds of names.

phrases.he: א' לפני האצילות
phrases.en: There's the names before the *Atzilus*,

phrases.he: והב' אחר האצילות
שהן הכלים המגבילים
phrases.en: That's the actual *kelim hamagbilim* of *Atzilus*.

blocks.text: So **there's two kinds of names** *Ayin Beis*, *SaG*: one before *Atzilus* and one after it. Like the name cat: there is one before the cat, which makes it what it is, a cat, and one after the cat, when you see it and say, "That's a cat."

blocks.question: How can it be *mamash* the same name? The name we say is just a symbol.
blocks.text: No. Look: you see the cat and you say, "That's a cat", the same name. And it is not just a symbol: when you say that name, it includes everything that a cat is.

blocks.title: A mouse in the bakery basement
blocks.text: Tell the owner of a bakery, "I saw a mouse in the basement," and you don't have to tell him anymore. It tells the whole story: the mouse is going to try to get into the bags of flour. You didn't say that; how does he know? Because the outer name is according to the actual mouse, which is according to the inner name. So its *sechel* will be a mouse *sechel*, its body a mouse body, it will hide in holes.
So **there's the names before the *Atzilus***, and those after it, which are **the actual *kelim hamagbilim*** (the limiting vessels) of *Atzilus*.

sections.title: Intending the Names: the kavanos reach the source
sections.summary: Whoever intends the outer Names intends their source, as hearing "mouse" brings the whole mouse to mind. This is what the *kavanos* of the *Arizal* in *Shemoneh Esrei* are: not prayer to vessels, but intent on the essence that the name calls.

phrases.he: ולפי זה המכוין בשמות מכוין במקור האורות
phrases.en: So when he's *mechavein* in the external names of *Atzilus*, he's automatically *mechavein* in the internal names.

blocks.title: What the mouse is thinking
blocks.text: Accordingly, one who intends the Names intends the source of the lights. Same as with the mouse: when the baker is *mechavein* (intends) what he was told, it is not just the external thing of a mouse but the internal thing: what the mouse is going to do, what a mouse is thinking. What is a mouse thinking? How to get into the bags of oats. Then he's going to poop all over the place and run around inside the walls.

sensitivity.reason: A crude word ("poop") in the picture of the mouse.
sensitivity.publishable: Accordingly, one who intends the Names intends the source of the lights. Same as with the mouse: when the baker is *mechavein* (intends) what he was told, it is not just the external thing of a mouse but the internal thing: what the mouse is going to do, what a mouse is thinking. What is a mouse thinking? How to get into the bags of oats. Then he's going to run around inside the walls.

blocks.text: **When he's *mechavein* in the external names of *Atzilus*, he's automatically *mechavein* in the internal names**, which are the outer names of *Adam Kadmon*, and from there in names higher still: in *Adam Kadmon* too there are inner names, which make it *Adam Kadmon*.

phrases.he: כמו מכוין בבחינת שם ע''ב, מקור לאור החכמה כו',
phrases.en: When he's *mechavein* in the *shem Ayin Beis* of the *kelim* of *Zeir Anpin* of *Atzilus*, he's *mechavein* in the *shem Ayin Beis* which is the *makor* of *chachma* of *Atzilus*.

phrases.he: וממילא הוא מכוון בכלי החכמה, שיומשך למטה כו'
phrases.en: And automatically he's also *mechavein* in the *kli* of the *chachma*, that it should bring down the light through this *kli* down to downstairs.

phrases.he: ודי למבין
phrases.en: So it's automatically *mechavein* both up and down.

blocks.text: So one who is *mechavein* in the Name *Ayin Beis* of the vessels of *Zeir Anpin* of *Atzilus* is *mechavein* in **the *shem Ayin Beis* which is the *makor* of *chachma* of *Atzilus***, its source.

blocks.title: Only a word, and he means the mouse
blocks.text: Same as with the mouse. All the baker heard was an outer name, a bunch of letters, nothing; and not only that, it was only a *mareh v'gavan* (an appearance and a color), not an actual mouse. Yet immediately he is *mechavein* on the actual mouse in the basement, and not only that, on its soul, its *ratzon*: *mamash* what the mouse wants to do, not just how it looks.

And automatically he is also *mechavein* in the vessel of *chachma*, **that it should bring down the light through this *kli* down to downstairs**: as when you call a person, you intend that he should come to you or talk to you. So **it's automatically *mechavein* both up and down**.

phrases.he: והיינו כוונות שמות דח''י ברכות שמונה עשרה
phrases.en: That's the *kavanos* in the *chai brachos* of *Shemoneh Esrei*; these are the *kavanos* of the *Arizal*.

blocks.text: This is the *kavanos* (intentions) of the Names in the eighteen blessings of *Shemoneh Esrei*: **the *kavanos* of the *Arizal***, the ones they talk about.

blocks.question: What do you have to be *mechavein* in? And how could you be *mechavein* in the vessels of *Zeir Anpin*: isn't that *avoda zara* (idol worship), praying to the vessels of *Zeir Anpin*?
blocks.text: No, that is not what he is doing. It is like saying a person's name: he is *mechavein* in the word, but really he is *mechavein* on the person's essence.

blocks.title: Talking about someone
blocks.text: A few minutes ago they were talking about someone and what he did. All that was heard was his external name, the one you can say in words, not his internal name. Yet the intention was really on his inner essence: how he does these things according to the *ratzon* and *chachma* that he has. That is how it is in the Names of the eighteen blessings.

phrases.he: כי הא בהא תליא,
phrases.en: Because one depends on the other.

phrases.he: משום דשורש הכלים המגבילים משמות דעצמות המאציל,
phrases.en: Because the *shoresh* of the external *kelim hamagbilim* comes from the *shemos* of *Atzmus hama'atzil*, that comes from the *shemos* of *Adam Kadmon*,

phrases.he: כמו שיתבאר
phrases.en: like will be explained later on some more.

phrases.he: ודי למבין)
phrases.en: And this is enough to understand it.

blocks.text: For **one depends on the other**. The external name depends on the internal name, and the internal name you get from the external name. How did he know that the inner name of that person was meant? Because the external name was said, so immediately he knew to intend the inner one. For the *shoresh* (root) of the external limiting vessels comes from the Names of the Essence of the *ma'atzil*, the Names of *Adam Kadmon*, **like will be explained later on some more**.
You call it a cat because that is what it is, a cat; and when you call it a cat, you know the inner thing of a cat.

blocks.title: A mouse in the house
blocks.text: Tell a lady there's a mouse in the house and she goes, "Ah!" What is she shouting about? It's just a word. No, it is not just a word: it has an inner meaning, a *kavana* of an actual thing that scares her.

sensitivity.reason: Builds the example on the stock picture of a woman screaming at a mouse.

blocks.title: "The British are coming"
blocks.text: Like Paul Revere: "The British are coming," and everybody jumps up and wakes up in the middle of the night. What are you waking up for? It's only a few words. But it tells you the inner thing of the whole thing.

sections.title: Tikunim: the limiting vessels are what let the light come down
sections.summary: The vessels of *Atzilus* are called *tikunim*, fixings, because like glasses for the eye they let the light reach further: only through a limiting vessel, as an intellect put into the letters of a book, can it be given to *Beriya* and below. In its own essence the light is still *bli ma*.

phrases.he: והיינו מה שכתוב וקרינן לון י' ספירין כו'
לאחזאה לאנהגא כו',
כי תיקונין הן בחינת הכלים לאורות דאצילות
phrases.en: That's the external names, in other words.

blocks.text: This is what is said: He makes *tikunim* (fixings), "which we call ten *sefiros*", to show through them His conduct; for the *tikunim* are the vessels of *Atzilus*: in other words, **the external names**.

phrases.he: וכמו על דרך משל תיקון העין, שיתפשט ראיה גשמית שבו יותר, הוא על ידי אמצעות כלי ההבטה כו'
phrases.en: Through glasses: to fix up the eye in order that you should see better is through a glass, a telescope, or a microscope.

phrases.he: כך תיקון התפשטות ראיה הרוחניות על ידי אמצעות כלי העין הגשמי כו'
phrases.en: The eye itself is also a *kli*: same like a telescope is a *kli* to the eye, the eye is a *kli* to the *re'iya ruchanis*.

phrases.he: וכמו שכתוב במקום אחר
phrases.en: And this is explained in other places.

blocks.title: Glasses, a telescope, a camera for the soul
blocks.text: Fixing the eye so that its physical sight reaches further is done through a vessel for looking: **a glass, a telescope, or a microscope**. In the same way, the fixing of spiritual sight, so that it spreads out, is through the vessel of the physical eye. **The eye itself is also a *kli***: as a telescope is to the eye, the eye is to the *re'iya ruchanis* (spiritual sight). It is like a camera for the soul, a TV camera.

phrases.he: על כן מצד בחינת הכלים המגבילים, על ידי זה דוקא יוכל להיות כל בחינת השפעות והמשכות למטה מטה
phrases.en: *Davka* through the *kelim hamagbilim*, like the hand: *davka* through that can be the *hashpaa*, the *hamshacha* downwards.

phrases.he: וכמו על ידי כלי המוח שישיג השכל, ימשיכנו להמדות
phrases.en: *Davka* through the *kli hamoach*, which will be *magbil* the *sechel* in the *hasaga*, that's how it'll be able to bring it to the *middos*,

phrases.he: או להשפיעו לזולתו
וכן על ידי אמצעות כלי הלב לאור האהבה והחסד הרוחני,
יבא לכלל השפעה למקבל כידוע
phrases.en: to give his love to somebody else, to love somebody.

blocks.text: Therefore it is *davka* through the limiting vessels that there can be all the influence and drawing down to the very bottom: **like the hand**, *davka* through it comes the *hashpaa* (giving), the *hamshacha* (drawing down) downwards.

As through the vessel of the brain, which limits the intellect in comprehension, he can bring it to the *middos*, or give it to another. So here: it is *davka* because the Rebbe put his intellect into the vessels of this book, its letters, that he can be *mashpia* (a giver) to us.
So too through the vessel of the heart, the spiritual light of love and kindness comes to be given to a receiver: **to give his love to somebody else**.

phrases.he: ולכך נקרא תיקונין,
phrases.en: That's why they're called fixings,

phrases.he: כדי שיבא על ידם בחינת המשכה מאצילות לבריאה
phrases.en: that through these external *kelim* of *Atzilus* will be able to be the *hamshacha* from *Atzilus* to *Beriya*.

phrases.he: והיינו רק לאחזאה כו'
phrases.en: Means just to show.

phrases.he: אבל מצד עצמות אור המאציל
phrases.en: But however, as far as the actual light in them,

phrases.he: נקרא עשר ספירות בלי מה
phrases.en: that's called without really a somethingness, like the essence of the *sechel* itself.

phrases.he: כנזכר לעיל, וכמו שכתוב במקום אחר באריכות:
phrases.en: And this is explained elsewhere at great length.

blocks.text: That is **why they're called fixings**: through these external vessels of *Atzilus* there can be the drawing down from *Atzilus* to *Beriya*. The word **means just to show**.

But **as far as the actual light in them**, they are called ten *sefiros bli ma*, without really a somethingness, like the essence of the intellect itself. The intellect of this book is not defined only by these letters: you could explain it with different *meshalim*, or with *Ayin Beis*, which explains the same matters in a totally different way.

So now you know all the *kavanos* of the *Arizal*, and this is the real thing people don't understand properly: what the *kavanos* are. They are like talking about a person: you mean his *etzem*, really, though all you said was his external name. He begins to add that even the outer name of a cat is not the word you say, and the tape ends.

reviewQuestions.question: Why is the light of *Atzilus* still called ten *sefiros bli ma*, though it is only a revelation, like a color?
How does a man's self-image show where the lights of the ten *sefiros* come from?
What is the difference between a cat's inner name and its outer name, and which of the two kinds of Names are the limiting vessels of *Atzilus*?
Why is intending the Names of the vessels of *Zeir Anpin* in *Shemoneh Esrei* not praying to vessels?
Why are the vessels called *tikunim*, and what do glasses and a telescope show about them?

notes.text: Line 1: he reads "ג' קוים" for the text's "ג' כלים" (042 w0-14) and does not translate it; its phrase has no English.

Line 4: he skips "כשלהבת כו' או" and reads "וגם גילוי הרצון עכשיו" (042 w48-56); the alignment mark for line 4 has confidence 0.387. Line 5: the transcript hears "קריאת ד' מראות" for "קורא הדורות מראש"; he says only "like it is explained before".

A person known to the class ("a few minutes ago we talked about [name]", 042 w3057-3174, w3203-3235, w3960-3978) is written as "someone" per STYLE.md. At w3035-3055 he says "when I say '[a name]', I'm mechavein in the word, but really to your essence"; the transcript's Hebrew word is unclear (perhaps a name), so the block says "a person's name".

042 w3906-3917: "Really, the Mitteler Rebbe's court is not limited to this thing." "Court" is probably misheard; the block keeps only the point he makes around it, that the light from the Rebbe is not limited to the letters of this book.

042 w3849-3879: one could explain the same matters "with Ayin Beis", in a totally different way. He does not say which work; it reads as the Rebbe Rashab's series of discourses of that name. The block keeps his words.
Line 28: at the first reading (w2208-2212) he goes straight into the cat; the phrase "There's the names before the Atzilus" cites his rereading at w2499-2505.
"Like what he says in Tanya, even" (w1551-1572): the stone example of the Tanya's Shaar HaYichud VehaEmuna, chapter 1. The block says only what he says.

The two flags on the Romans and Esav (w401-458, w498-547) lean raw: Esav as cruelty is a traditional teaching and the Romans are an ancient people, but a reader might take Esav for a living group. The "poop" and the woman screaming at a mouse are softened.
The tape (sofer times; the seconds may be off) ends mid-sentence at w4021, as he starts to say that the outer name of a cat is not the word you say. This is the series' only class on chapter 28.
